title: fix(components): Combobox search finds an option by its label, not only its value (objectui#13229)
body:
Fixes #13229

Clause-②: no

## What changed

The shared `Combobox` in `@object-ui/components` now finds an option by its visible label as well as by its value. What a pick commits is unchanged: `onValueChange` still receives the option's `value`.

- `packages/components/src/custom/combobox.tsx`: each `CommandItem` gets the option's label as a cmdk keyword. `value` stays the option's value.
- `packages/components/src/__tests__/combobox-label-search.test.tsx`: new tests.
- `.changeset/13229-combobox-label-search.md`: `@object-ui/components` patch.

Not touched: the consumers (`AuditLogPage`, `ObjectRefField`, `RecipientPickerField`, `RegistryRefField`, `WidgetConfigPanel`, the `combobox` schema node). They inherit the fix.

## Mechanism, measured in the installed cmdk (1.1.1)

- **H1 holds.** An item's search text is the first string among its `value` prop, its children and its DOM text, in that order. A `value` prop is always a string here, so the children are never read. The default filter scores `value` joined with `keywords` against the query. So the label, rendered only as a child, was never searched.
- **H2, the fix shape.** `keywords` is cmdk's own door for extra search text. The combobox had no custom `filter` or `shouldFilter`, so nothing needed extending.
- **H2, the non-string label.** `label` is declared `string` on both faces of `ComboboxOption`: the TypeScript interface in `@object-ui/types` and `ComboboxOptionSchema` in the zod mirror. A React node cannot reach it. Every typed consumer is checked by the compiler, and JSON cannot carry one. The `combobox` schema node, however, passes JSON options through unvalidated at render, and cmdk calls `.trim()` on every keyword. A probe, never committed, measured what an out-of-contract label does on each tree:

| Label | Keyword removed (as on `main`) | Keyword passed unguarded | This PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| `5` (a number) | renders | throws `m.trim is not a function` | renders |
| missing | renders | throws reading `trim` of undefined | renders |
| an object | throws (React child) | throws (React child) | throws (React child), as on `main` |
| a string | renders | renders | renders |

So a keyword is passed only for a string label: `keywords={typeof option.label === "string" ? [option.label] : undefined}`. An option with a non-string label stays searchable by its value only, as it is on `main`. Nothing is coerced or widened, and the declared type is unchanged.

## Tests (at `c0659ab45`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/src/__tests__/combobox-label-search.test.tsx`: `Tests 8 passed (8)`.
- The four existing combobox suites in `packages/components/src/__tests__/` plus the new one: `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 29 passed (29)` at `fab9093ae`. The new file then gained the non-string test.
- The whole package, `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/`: `Test Files 416 passed | 1 skipped (417)`, `Tests 4160 passed | 24 skipped (4184)`, vitest exit 0.
- Consumer suites that render these pickers: `AuditLogPage.*` (5 files), `RecipientPickerField` (2), `RegistryRefField.*` (2), `widget-aria-invalid-registry-e2e`, `widget-dom-leak-e2e`, `widgetRefCells-12613`, `WidgetConfigPanel*` (4) and `ConfigPanel.i18nWiring`: `Test Files 17 passed (17)`, `Tests 571 passed (571)`.

New tests: typing "Opportunities" finds `Opportunities (crm_opp)`; typing "成员" finds `成员 (showcase_project_membership)`; typing "Alice Zhang" finds the option whose value is a record id. Controls: a value fragment still finds its option, ranked first; a click or Enter on an option found by its label commits its value; a query matching neither shows the empty state. One more test covers the out-of-contract labels above.

**Ablations** (`ablation-replace` from objectstack, wrap mode; the fix was committed first, and each leg's restore was proven by blob hash equal to `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`). The test imports the component from `src` by a relative path, so no `dist` is involved:

- **A: keyword removed.** `Tests 5 failed | 3 passed (8)`. Red: the three label searches, plus the two commit controls, which reach their option through a label. Green: the value-fragment control, the empty-state control and the non-string test.
- **B: keyword passed unguarded** (`keywords={[option.label]}`). `Tests 1 failed | 7 passed (8)`. Red: the non-string test only.

## Chromium reading (Chromium 141, the console's Vite with a scratch entry, as the card's census did)

The census entry renders the real `Combobox` with the Audit Log object filter's options (`Label (name)`), plus the real `ObjectRefField`, `RecipientPickerField` (kind `user`) and `RegistryRefField` (position) over stub data sources. The left column is the same harness with the keyword removed. It reproduces the card's census.

| Picker | Typed | Keyword removed | This PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| Audit Log object filter | `Opportunities` | 0 | 1 (Opportunities (crm_opp)) |
| Audit Log object filter | `crm_opp` | 1 | 2 (Opportunities (crm_opp), 成员 (showcase_project_membership)) |
| Audit Log object filter | `Accounts` | 0 | 1 (Accounts (crm_account)) |
| Audit Log object filter | `Sharing Rule` | 0 | 1 (Sharing Rule (sys_sharing_rule)) |
| Audit Log object filter | `成员` | 0 | 1 (成员 (showcase_project_membership)) |
| Audit Log object filter | `membership` | 1 | 1 (成员 (showcase_project_membership)) |

| ObjectRefField | `成员` | 0 | 1 (成员 (showcase_project_membership)) |

No page errors on either tree.

Before that build it exited 2 with unresolved `@object-ui/*` imports across the package, not a reading of this change. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new test file.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, `0 new citation(s)`.

The gate list is hand-derived: `dispatch-gates.mjs` does not serve this repository. CI runs the full set.

## Acceptance notes

- **The fuzzy match now spans the value and the label.** cmdk matches a fuzzy subsequence over the value and the keywords joined, so a value fragment can also match across the join. `crm_opp` now lists `成员 (showcase_project_membership)` second, and `sales` lists `Support Lead (support_lead)` second. The exact option ranks first, and Enter commits it. This is cmdk's own scoring. A custom `filter` that scores the value and the label separately would remove it, but nothing here measured it as harmful.
- **A user's email still finds nothing** in `RecipientPickerField` (kind `user`). The email is not part of the option's visible label there, so it is outside this card.
- **An object label still throws** (React child), as on `main`. It is out of contract, and this PR does not change it.
